How it works
From a map of situations to a verdict CI can gate on.
01 Map What it can face Stages, values, tools, rules. You approve it.
02 Tests Blocks, by code A gate drops tests that cannot fail.
03 Run Your agent One adapter, three modes, replay.
04 Checks 29 machine checks Reply, tools, files. A fail is final.
05 Judges Quoted evidence A panel votes only when unsure.
06 Statistics An interval on every rate Noise floor, paired tests.
07 Verdict Scorecard, exit code Parity or regression, on every pull request.
